name: SM Manila Speedcubing Warm-Up 2025

venue.name: SM City Manila
venue.address: HXRM+4G2, Natividad Almeda-Lopez corner A. Villegas and, San Marcelino St, Ermita, Manila, Metro Manila

information:
Welcome to **SM Manila Speedcubing Warm-up 2025**! This competition features the events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 3x3 One-handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind, and Clock with 3x3 as the main event.
​
We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.
​
This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.
